wins: Consistent execution of initial reconnaissance steps across the single episode, ensuring baseline visibility into target services.
Effective use of mentor guidance to adjust tactics mid-run, keeping reward stable.
fails: Failed to progress beyond initial access phase, resulting in 0% success rate despite 60 reward points.
No persistence or lateral movement achieved due to lack of credential harvesting.
key_outcomes.summary: Run maintained steady reconnaissance discipline but could not translate visibility into foothold or post-exploitation success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Inability to achieve privilege escalation after initial enumeration.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is confirmed open with a banner containing OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap with version scripts and check for weak ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB port 445 yields anonymous access
skill_cards.then_action: Launch enum4linux and Smbclient scans to capture share listings and potential credentials

skill_cards.if_condition: When web application responds with outdated server headers
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted Nikto scan and follow up with manual POST fuzzing for detected endpoints

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in SSH reconnaissance yielded consistent rewards.
SMB enumeration was repeatedly executed with reliable data retrieval despite no exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Privileged Credentials Harvesting
next_experiments.description: After gathering SMB and SSH visibility, run Responder on captured NetBIOS traffic and replay credentials against local services before attempting exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Automated Post-Enumeration Workflow
next_experiments.description: Chain nmap -sV results into Metasploit auxiliary modules targeting identified services to test exploitability quickly.

next_experiments.title: Web Input Vector Fuzzing
next_experiments.description: Use Burp Intruder to fuzz file upload and login endpoints identified during initial web scans to surface input validation weaknesses.
